workarounds.symptom: Adapter loading never warns about unexpected keys, and `strict=True` is silently ignored
workarounds.workaround: Fix: FIX strict_adapter_check for load_adapter and from_pretrained. Target files: src/peft/peft_model.py, tests/test_custom_models.py, tests/test_decoder_models.py. `load_adapter` never warned about unexpected keys, and neither method accepted a `strict` argument, it silently landed in `**kwargs` and was dropped. Adds `strict_adapter_check: bool = False` to both, raising a `RuntimeError` when the checkpoint has adapter keys missing from, or unexpected for, the model, after filtering out keys that are expected to differ for struc... (Ref: https://github.com/huggingface/peft/pull/3832)

workarounds.symptom: AdaLoRA Conv2d crashes in forward and merge with groups > 1
workarounds.workaround: Fix: FIX AdaLoRA Conv2d with groups and padding_mode. Target files: src/peft/tuners/adalora/layer.py, tests/test_initialization.py, tests/test_vision_models.py. - `SVDConv2d.lora_A` is now sized `in_channels // groups * kH * kW`, so `groups > 1` no longer fails in forward and merge. - The adapter branch now uses `base._conv_forward`, so it respects `padding_mode` (it was always zero-padded). (Ref: https://github.com/huggingface/peft/pull/4084)

workarounds.symptom: FRoD fails on MPS: weights are cast to float64 before moving to CPU
workarounds.workaround: Fix: FIX macOS test failures and MPS float64 errors in FRoD and EVA. Target files: src/peft/tuners/frod/layer.py, src/peft/utils/incremental_pca.py, tests/test_frod.py. Fixes the failures from the first nightly macOS run (https://github.com/huggingface/peft/actions/runs/41554512499) and two MPS float64 crashes that the run can't see. (Ref: https://github.com/huggingface/peft/pull/4102)

workarounds.symptom: reduce_intruder_dimension gives wrong LoRA factors for fan_in_fan_out (Conv1D) and Embedding layers
workarounds.workaround: Fix: FIX reduce_intruder_dimension for fan_in_fan_out and embedding LoRA layers. Target files: src/peft/tuners/lora/intruders.py, tests/test_lora_intruders.py. `reduce_intruder_dimension` rebuilt `lora_A` and `lora_B` from the SVD of `get_delta_weight` without transposing it for `fan_in_fan_out` (GPT-2 `Conv1D`) and `nn.Embedding` layers, whose delta is in the base weight layout. The new factors had the wrong shape, so a square `Conv1D` gave wrong output silently and other shapes failed in `forward`. (Ref: https://github.com/huggingface/peft/pull/4100)

workarounds.symptom: merge_and_unload(adapter_names=...) retains the wrong modules_to_save classifier
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Fix modules_to_save selection when merging an inactive adapter. Target files: src/peft/tuners/tuners_utils.py, src/peft/utils/other.py, tests/test_custom_models.py. . Approved by @BenjaminBossan. merge_and_unload(adapter_names=...) merged the requested backbone adapter but kept the active adapter's modules_to_save copy instead. This PR selects the correct saved copy using the existing checks for each wrapper. If none of the requested adapters has a saved copy for a wrapper, it restores the original module. Default merging a... (Ref: https://github.com/huggingface/peft/pull/4085)

workarounds.symptom: AdaMSS example scripts broken on transformers 5.x
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Fix broken examples on transformers 5.x (target_modules, dataset IDs, warmup_ratio). Target files: examples/adamss_finetuning/glue_adamss_asa_example.py, examples/adamss_finetuning/glue_adamss_asa_manual_example.py, examples/adamss_finetuning/image_classification_adamss_asa.py. Transformers 5.x renamed ViT and MiT-b0 attention projections from `query`/`value` to `q_proj`/`v_proj`, removed `warmup_ratio` from `TrainingArguments`, and non-namespaced dataset IDs now fail with `HfUriError`. (Ref: https://github.com/huggingface/peft/pull/4086)
